teks_id: Dahulu kala, ada dataran luas bernama Dataran Kedu. Di sekelilingnya berdiri Gunung Sindoro, Sumbing, Merapi, Merbabu, dan Perbukitan Menoreh. Setiap malam, desa-desanya diterangi cahaya lembut yang disebut Cahaya Kedu.
teks_en: Long ago, there was a wide plain called the Kedu Plain. Around it stood Mount Sindoro, Mount Sumbing, Mount Merapi, Mount Merbabu, and the Menoreh Hills. Every night, its villages glowed with a gentle light called the Light of Kedu.

teks_id: Cahaya itu lahir dari ilmu dan budaya. Ia datang dari dongeng para kakek dan nenek, dari relief Candi Borobudur, dan dari tembang para petani. Ia juga menyala setiap kali seseorang membaca dengan teliti. Cahaya itu disimpan di dalam sebuah lentera tua bernama Lentera Kedu.
teks_en: That light was born from knowledge and culture. It came from grandparents' tales, from the reliefs of Borobudur Temple, and from the songs of the farmers. It also shone every time someone read with care. The light was kept inside an old lantern called the Lantern of Kedu.

teks_id: Namun perlahan, orang-orang mulai lupa. Mereka membaca dengan terburu-buru, memercayai kabar tanpa memeriksanya, membagikan apa saja tanpa berpikir, dan meninggalkan cerita para leluhur. Dari kebiasaan itu, naiklah kabut kelabu yang dingin. Namanya Kabut Lupa.
teks_en: But slowly, people began to forget. They read in a hurry, believed news without checking it, shared anything without thinking, and left their ancestors' stories behind. From those habits, a cold grey mist rose up. It was called the Mist of Forgetting.

teks_id: Pada suatu malam, Kabut Lupa melilit Lentera Kedu. Kacanya retak, apinya bergetar, lalu cahayanya pecah! Lima belas Serpihan Cahaya melesat ke langit dan jatuh di Temanggung, Magelang, dan Wonosobo.
teks_en: One night, the Mist of Forgetting coiled around the Lantern of Kedu. Its glass cracked, its flame trembled, and then its light shattered! Fifteen Shards of Light shot into the sky and fell across Temanggung, Magelang, and Wonosobo.

teks_id: Aku Mbah Kedu, penjaga lentera ini. Kakiku sudah tua, jadi aku hanya bisa menemanimu pelan-pelan. Setiap kali cahayanya meredup, tubuhku ikut melemah. Aku butuh anak yang berani dan mau membaca dengan sungguh-sungguh.
teks_en: I am Mbah Kedu, which means Grandpa Kedu, the keeper of this lantern. My legs are old, so I can only walk slowly beside you. Each time its light fades, my body grows weaker too. I need a child who is brave and willing to read with all their heart.

teks_id: Biar aku yang pergi, Mbah! Aku akan mencari kelima belas serpihan itu satu per satu, sampai Lentera Kedu menyala lagi. Aku janji!
teks_en: Let me go, Mbah! I will find all fifteen shards, one by one, until the Lantern of Kedu shines again. I promise!

teks_id: Setiap wilayah menyimpan lima serpihan, dan setiap serpihan dijaga oleh satu tantangan. Selesaikan tantangannya untuk mendapatkan serpihan dan bintang. Lihat papan Serpihan Cahaya di bagian atas layar: cahayanya bertambah setiap kali serpihan kembali.
teks_en: Each region holds five shards, and each shard is guarded by a challenge. Complete the challenge to win its shard and stars. Watch the Shards of Light panel at the top of the screen: its light grows every time a shard returns.

teks_id: Ingat tiga kunci ini, Le. Di Temanggung, temukan informasi yang tertulis jelas. Di Magelang, hubungkan informasi dan bedakan fakta dari pendapat. Di Wonosobo, timbang setiap informasi dan dari mana asalnya.
teks_en: Remember these three keys, my boy. In Temanggung, find the information that is clearly written. In Magelang, connect information and tell facts from opinions. In Wonosobo, weigh every piece of information and where it comes from.

teks_id: Dan kamu, penjelajah, akan berjalan bersama Jaka. Bacalah dengan teliti, pikirkan baik-baik, dan putuskan dengan bijak. Kabut Lupa sudah menunggu. Mari nyalakan kembali Cahaya Kedu!
teks_en: And you, explorer, will walk beside Jaka. Read carefully, think it through, and decide wisely. The Mist of Forgetting is waiting. Let us bring back the Light of Kedu!

teks_id: Inilah Dataran Kedu. Dulu dataran ini menyimpan cahaya ilmu dan budaya. Sekarang lihatlah... Kabut Lupa menutupi hampir semuanya.
teks_en: This is the Kedu Plain. This plain once held the light of knowledge and culture. Now look... the Mist of Forgetting covers almost all of it.

teks_id: Aku harus menjelajahi tiga wilayah untuk memulihkannya: Temanggung, lalu Magelang, dan terakhir Wonosobo. Di setiap wilayah, lima Serpihan Cahaya sedang menunggu.
teks_en: I must explore three regions to bring it back: Temanggung, then Magelang, and finally Wonosobo. In each region, five Shards of Light are waiting.

teks_id: Ketuk tombol Kenali di setiap wilayah untuk mendengar cerita Mbah Kedu tentang tempat itu. Kalau sudah siap, pilih wilayah yang sudah terbuka, lalu ketuk Lanjut. Ayo, kita berangkat!
teks_en: Tap Get to know on each region to hear Mbah Kedu's story about that place. When you are ready, choose an open region and tap Continue. Come on, let's go!

teks_id: Inilah Temanggung, Le. Tanahnya diapit dua gunung, Sindoro dan Sumbing. Kalau pagi cerah, kedua puncaknya tampak berdiri berdampingan, seperti kakak dan adik yang saling menjaga. Di lereng Sindoro ada mata air Umbul Jumprit, hulu Sungai Progo.
teks_en: This is Temanggung, my boy. It lies between two mountains, Sindoro and Sumbing. On a clear morning, their peaks stand side by side, like an older and a younger sibling looking after each other. On the slopes of Sindoro is the Umbul Jumprit spring, the source of the Progo River.

teks_id: Tanah di lereng gunung ini sangat subur. Para petani menanam tembakau, kopi, dan sayuran. Kopi dari lereng Sindoro dan Sumbing terkenal harum sampai ke luar daerah. Sungai-sungainya yang jernih menjadi rumah ikan uceng, ikan sungai yang kecil. Uceng goreng adalah makanan khas Temanggung.
teks_en: The soil on these mountain slopes is very fertile. Farmers grow tobacco, coffee, and vegetables. Coffee from the slopes of Sindoro and Sumbing is famous for its aroma, even far beyond the region. Its clear rivers are home to the uceng, a small river fish. Fried uceng is a special dish of Temanggung.

teks_id: Temanggung juga menyimpan jejak masa lalu. Ada Situs Liyangan, permukiman kuno yang pernah tertimbun pasir dan batu dari letusan Gunung Sindoro. Ada pula Candi Pringapus dengan arca lembu Nandi di dalamnya, dan Prasasti Gondosuli yang diperkirakan dibuat sekitar tahun 832 Masehi.
teks_en: Temanggung also keeps traces of the past. There is the Liyangan Site, an ancient settlement once buried under sand and stones from an eruption of Mount Sindoro. There is also Pringapus Temple, with a statue of Nandi the bull inside, and the Gondosuli Inscription, thought to date from around 832 CE.

teks_id: Saat ada perayaan, warga menari kuda lumping, yang juga disebut jaran kepang. Penarinya menunggang kuda kepang, kuda-kudaan dari anyaman bambu. Di sini kamu belajar menemukan informasi yang tertulis jelas di gambar, teks pendek, dan suara. Bacalah dengan teliti karena jawabannya sering ada di depan mata.
teks_en: At celebrations, people dance the kuda lumping, also called jaran kepang. The dancers ride a kuda kepang, a horse made of woven bamboo. Here you will learn to find information that is clearly stated in pictures, short texts, and sounds. Read carefully, because the answer is often right in front of you.

teks_id: Magelang, Le, adalah rumah Candi Borobudur, candi Buddha terbesar di dunia. Candi itu dibangun lebih dari seribu tahun lalu, batu demi batu, tanpa mesin modern.
teks_en: Magelang, my boy, is home to Borobudur Temple, the largest Buddhist temple in the world. It was built more than a thousand years ago, stone by stone, without modern machines.

teks_id: Dinding Borobudur dihiasi 2.672 panel relief, dan lebih dari separuhnya bercerita. Membaca relief itu seperti membaca buku raksasa dari batu: urutannya harus benar supaya ceritanya utuh.
teks_en: Borobudur's walls are decorated with 2,672 relief panels, and more than half of them tell stories. Reading those reliefs is like reading a giant book made of stone: the order must be right for the story to make sense.

teks_id: Tak jauh dari Borobudur ada Candi Mendut dan Candi Pawon. Ketiganya berdiri hampir segaris. Setiap Waisak, umat Buddha berjalan dari Mendut ke Borobudur membawa air suci dari Umbul Jumprit, Temanggung. Di tengah kota ada Gunung Tidar, si paku tanah Jawa dalam cerita rakyat.
teks_en: Not far from Borobudur stand Mendut Temple and Pawon Temple. The three temples stand almost in a straight line. Every Vesak, Buddhists walk from Mendut to Borobudur carrying holy water from Umbul Jumprit in Temanggung. In the middle of the city is Mount Tidar, the nail of Java in folk tales.

teks_id: Jangan lewatkan tari Topeng Ireng yang gagah. Penarinya memakai kuluk, hiasan kepala dari bulu warna-warni. Di Magelang, satu informasi saja tidak cukup. Kamu harus menghubungkan beberapa informasi, lalu membedakan mana fakta dan mana pendapat.
teks_en: Don't miss the bold Topeng Ireng dance. The dancers wear a kuluk, a headdress of colourful feathers. In Magelang, one piece of information is not enough. You must connect several pieces of information, then tell which are facts and which are opinions.

teks_id: Wonosobo adalah pintu menuju Dataran Tinggi Dieng, yang dijuluki negeri di atas awan. Letaknya sangat tinggi, sampai-sampai awan dan kabut sering lewat di antara rumah penduduk.
teks_en: Wonosobo is the gateway to the Dieng Plateau, known as the land above the clouds. It is so high up that clouds and mist often drift between people's houses.

teks_id: Di Dieng berdiri kompleks Candi Arjuna, salah satu candi Hindu tertua di Jawa. Ada juga Telaga Warna, yang airnya mengandung belerang sehingga bisa tampak hijau, biru, atau kekuningan. Warga Dieng juga punya tradisi memotong rambut gimbal, yaitu rambut yang menggumpal dengan sendirinya, pada anak-anak.
teks_en: On Dieng stands the Arjuna Temple complex, one of the oldest Hindu temples in Java. There is also Telaga Warna, the Lake of Colours, whose sulphurous water can look green, blue, or yellowish. The people of Dieng also keep a tradition of cutting the naturally matted hair of some children.

teks_id: Udara di sini dingin sekali. Warga menghangatkan badan dengan teh dari kebun Tambi dan mi ongklok berkuah kental. Mi itu direbus di ongklok, keranjang bambu kecil yang dicelup-celupkan ke air mendidih. Ada juga manisan carica, si pepaya gunung.
teks_en: The air here is very cold. People warm up with tea from the Tambi estate and ongklok noodles in a thick sauce. The noodles are boiled in an ongklok, a small bamboo basket dipped into boiling water. There is also sweet carica, the mountain papaya.

teks_id: Di sini ada tari Topeng Lengger dan bundengan, alat musik dari tudung bambu penggembala bebek. Tapi di sinilah Kabut Lupa paling tebal, Le. Kamu akan menemukan banyak kabar, dan tidak semuanya benar. Periksa sumbernya, timbang alasannya, lalu putuskan dengan bijak.
teks_en: Here you will find the Topeng Lengger mask dance and the bundengan, an instrument made from a duck herder's bamboo hood. But this is also where the Mist of Forgetting is thickest, my boy. You will come across a lot of news, and not all of it is true. Check the source, weigh the reasons, then decide wisely.

teks_id: Kita sudah sampai, Le. Temanggung... Dulu, dari bukit ini, lampu-lampu desa tampak seperti bintang yang jatuh ke ladang. Sekarang lihatlah. Semuanya kelabu.
teks_en: We're here, my boy. Temanggung... From this hill, the village lights used to look like stars that had fallen onto the fields. Now look. Everything is grey.

teks_id: Kabutnya tebal sekali, Mbah. Aku hampir tidak bisa melihat jalan setapak di depan kita.
teks_en: The mist is so thick, Mbah. I can hardly see the path in front of us.

teks_id: Kabut Lupa turun ke sini lebih dulu. Dengar itu? Warga saling memanggil di tengah ladang. Mereka tersesat di kampung mereka sendiri.
teks_en: The Mist of Forgetting came here first. Do you hear that? People are calling to each other across the fields. They are lost in their own village.

teks_id: Tersesat? Bagaimana bisa, Mbah? Bukankah di setiap persimpangan ada papan petunjuk?
teks_en: Lost? How, Mbah? Isn't there a signpost at every crossroads?

teks_id: Ada. Tapi kabut membuat tulisannya samar. Orang hanya melirik sekilas, lalu menebak arah. Kalau tebakannya keliru, mereka bisa berputar-putar di ladang sampai senja.
teks_en: There is. But the mist makes the writing faint. People only glance at it, then guess the way. If they guess wrong, they can wander in circles through the fields until dusk.

teks_id: Kalau begitu kita harus cepat, Mbah! Aku langsung cari serpihannya saja. Pasti ada yang bersinar di balik kabut!
teks_en: Then we have to hurry, Mbah! I'll just go straight for the shards. Something must be shining behind the mist!

teks_id: Lihat, ada papan petunjuk! Tulisannya "Jembatan", panahnya ke kanan... Ayo, Mbah, lewat sini!
teks_en: Look, a signpost! It says "Bridge", and the arrow points right... Come on, Mbah, this way!

teks_id: Tunggu, Le! Berhenti! Jangan hanya melihat panahnya. Baca dulu seluruh tulisannya.
teks_en: Wait, my boy! Stop! Don't just look at the arrow. Read all the words first.

teks_id: "Jembatan rusak! Silakan lewat jalan kiri." Aduh... Kalau tadi aku langsung berlari ke kanan, kita bisa tercebur ke sungai.
teks_en: "Bridge broken! Please take the left path." Oh no... If I had run straight to the right, we could have fallen into the river.

teks_id: Nah. Mata yang terburu-buru melewatkan jawaban yang tertulis jelas. Kabut Lupa paling senang kalau kita terburu-buru.
teks_en: There, you see. Hurried eyes miss answers that are written clearly. The Mist of Forgetting is happiest when we rush.

teks_id: Maaf, Mbah. Aku cuma ingin cepat-cepat menolong semua orang.
teks_en: I'm sorry, Mbah. I just wanted to help everyone as fast as I could.

teks_id: Niatmu baik, Le. Tapi menolong juga butuh ketelitian. Lihat, begitu kamu membaca dengan benar, kabut di papan itu menipis. Di balik bukit, serpihan cahaya pertama mulai berkilau.
teks_en: Your heart is in the right place, my boy. But helping also takes care. Look, as soon as you read it properly, the mist on that sign grew thinner. Behind the hill, the first shard of light is starting to sparkle.

teks_id: Aku mengerti sekarang. Aku akan membaca kata demi kata, melihat gambar dengan saksama, dan mendengarkan baik-baik.
teks_en: I understand now. I will read word by word, look at pictures closely, and listen carefully.

teks_id: Lima serpihan menunggumu di Temanggung. Temukan informasi yang tertulis jelas, maka kabut ini akan mundur dengan sendirinya.
teks_en: Five shards are waiting for you in Temanggung. Find the information that is clearly written, and this mist will retreat on its own.

teks_id: Tunggu kami, warga Temanggung! Lentera ini akan menyala untuk kalian!
teks_en: Hold on, people of Temanggung! This lantern will shine for you!

teks_id: Mbah, lihat lenteraku! Serpihan dari Temanggung sudah menyala di dalamnya. Magelang pasti lebih mudah!
teks_en: Mbah, look at my lantern! The shards from Temanggung are glowing inside it. Magelang will be easy!

teks_id: Jangan cepat merasa hebat, Le. Kabut di Magelang punya jebakan yang lain.
teks_en: Don't feel too sure of yourself, my boy. The mist in Magelang has other traps.

teks_id: Jebakan apa, Mbah? Itu Candi Borobudur, kan? Megah sekali... Tapi kenapa relief-reliefnya tampak aneh?
teks_en: What traps, Mbah? That's Borobudur Temple, isn't it? It's magnificent... But why do the reliefs look strange?

teks_id: Kabut Lupa mengacak urutannya. Awal cerita ada di akhir, akhir cerita ada di tengah. Siapa pun yang membacanya sekarang hanya mendapat potongan-potongan yang membingungkan.
teks_en: The Mist of Forgetting has jumbled their order. The beginning of the story is at the end, and the end is in the middle. Anyone who reads them now only gets confusing bits and pieces.

teks_id: Mbah, dengar... Di bawah sana ada dua bapak yang sedang bertengkar.
teks_en: Mbah, listen... Down there, two men are arguing.

teks_id: Bapak yang satu berteriak, "Candi ini dibangun dengan semen!" Bapak yang lain membalas, "Bukan! Candi ini baru dibangun seratus tahun lalu!"
teks_en: One man shouts, "This temple was built with cement!" The other shouts back, "No! It was built only a hundred years ago!"

teks_id: Jadi, mana yang benar, Mbah?
teks_en: So which one is right, Mbah?

teks_id: Itulah tugasmu, Le. Pendapat boleh berbeda-beda, tetapi fakta bisa dibuktikan. Hubungkan informasi yang satu dengan yang lain, maka kebenaran akan terlihat.
teks_en: That is your task, my boy. Opinions may differ, but facts can be proven. Connect one piece of information with another, and the truth will appear.

teks_id: Uhh... Maaf, Le. Kaki Mbah gemetar. Setiap kali kabut menebal, tenaga Mbah seperti ikut tersedot.
teks_en: Ohh... Forgive me, my boy. My legs are shaking. Every time the mist grows thicker, it feels like my strength is being drained away.

teks_id: Mbah! Mbah tidak apa-apa? Tangan Mbah dingin sekali!
teks_en: Mbah! Are you all right? Your hands are so cold!

teks_id: Tenang... Mbah hanya perlu duduk sebentar. Cahaya lentera dan tubuh tua ini saling terikat, Le. Semakin banyak serpihan kembali, semakin kuat Mbah.
teks_en: Don't worry... I just need to sit for a while. The lantern's light and this old body are bound together, my boy. The more shards return, the stronger I become.

teks_id: Kalau begitu, Mbah istirahat saja di sini. Biar aku yang menyusun cerita-cerita itu kembali.
teks_en: Then rest here, Mbah. Let me put those stories back together.

teks_id: Kamu sudah berbeda dari anak yang dulu berlari ke papan petunjuk tanpa membacanya.
teks_en: You are not the same child who once ran towards a signpost without reading it.

teks_id: Karena aku belajar dari Mbah. Baca dengan teliti dulu, baru bertindak!
teks_en: Because I learned from you, Mbah. Read carefully first, then act!

teks_id: Ingat pesan Mbah: temukan gagasan pokoknya, susun urutannya, dan pisahkan fakta dari pendapat. Lima serpihan Magelang menunggumu.
teks_en: Remember my advice: find the main idea, put things in order, and separate facts from opinions. Five shards of Magelang are waiting for you.

teks_id: Aku berangkat, Mbah. Sebelum senja, relief-relief itu akan bercerita dengan benar lagi!
teks_en: I'm off, Mbah. Before dusk, those reliefs will tell their stories the right way again!

teks_id: Brrr... Dingin sekali, Mbah. Kabutnya sampai masuk ke sela-sela jariku.
teks_en: Brrr... It's freezing, Mbah. The mist is even creeping between my fingers.

teks_id: Kita di Dieng, Le, negeri di atas awan. Tapi kabut ini bukan kabut biasa. Di sinilah jantung Kabut Lupa.
teks_en: We are on Dieng, my boy, the land above the clouds. But this is no ordinary mist. This is the heart of the Mist of Forgetting.

teks_id: Mbah, dengar! Ada warga yang panik memukul kentongan. Orang-orang berlarian sambil memegang ponsel!
teks_en: Mbah, listen! A frightened villager is beating the kentongan, a wooden alarm drum. People are running around holding their phones!

teks_id: Mereka menerima pesan berantai: "Besok pagi akan ada gempa besar di Dieng! Cepat mengungsi! Sebarkan ke semua orang!"
teks_en: They have received a chain message: "A big earthquake will hit Dieng tomorrow morning! Evacuate now! Share this with everyone!"

teks_id: Apa pesan itu benar, Mbah? Aku jadi cemas...
teks_en: Is that message true, Mbah? It makes me worried...

teks_id: Pertanyaanmu penting, Le. Jawabannya tersembunyi di balik kabut ini, dan kamulah yang akan menemukannya.
teks_en: That's an important question, my boy. The answer is hidden behind this mist, and you are the one who will find it.

teks_id: Le... Mbah tidak kuat naik lebih tinggi lagi. Napas Mbah pendek, dan kaki ini sudah tidak mau melangkah.
teks_en: My boy... I cannot climb any higher. My breath is short, and these legs will not take another step.

teks_id: Tidak, Mbah! Aku tidak mau berjalan sendirian! Bagaimana kalau aku salah memilih?
teks_en: No, Mbah! I don't want to go on alone! What if I choose wrongly?

teks_id: Mbah akan menunggumu di tepi Telaga Warna. Dari sana, Mbah bisa melihat cahayamu setiap kali satu serpihan kembali.
teks_en: I will wait for you on the shore of Telaga Warna. From there, I can see your light every time a shard returns.

teks_id: Aku takut, Mbah...
teks_en: I'm scared, Mbah...

teks_id: Takut itu wajar, Le. Lentera ini menyala karena keberanianmu, bukan karena kamu tidak pernah takut.
teks_en: Being scared is normal, my boy. This lantern shines because of your courage, not because you are never afraid.

teks_id: Dengarkan pesan Mbah. Apa pun yang kamu temui, bacalah sekali lagi sebelum memutuskan.
teks_en: Listen to my advice. Whatever you come across, read it once more before you decide.

teks_id: Baca sekali lagi sebelum memutuskan... Aku akan mengingatnya, Mbah.
teks_en: Read it once more before deciding... I will remember, Mbah.

teks_id: Warga Dieng tidak butuh kepanikan. Mereka butuh kabar yang benar. Dan aku akan membantu mereka menemukannya.
teks_en: The people of Dieng don't need panic. They need the truth. And I will help them find it.

teks_id: Itu baru anak pemberani. Pergilah, Le. Lima serpihan terakhir menunggu di balik kabut.
teks_en: Now that's a brave child. Go, my boy. The last five shards are waiting behind the mist.

teks_id: Tunggu aku di Telaga Warna, Mbah. Saat aku kembali, Lentera Kedu akan menyala paling terang!
teks_en: Wait for me at Telaga Warna, Mbah. When I come back, the Lantern of Kedu will shine brighter than ever!

teks_id: Mbah, empat serpihan Temanggung sudah kembali! Tapi cahaya lenteraku belum utuh. Di mana serpihan kelima?
teks_en: Mbah, four of Temanggung's shards are back! But my lantern's light still isn't whole. Where is the fifth shard?

teks_id: Lihat anak-anak di bawah pohon itu, Le. Mereka menunduk menatap layar tablet. Ada kabut tipis yang keluar dari layarnya.
teks_en: Look at the children under that tree, my boy. They are bent over a tablet. A thin mist is drifting out of its screen.

teks_id: Kabut Lupa bisa masuk ke dalam layar, Mbah? Pantas saja unggahan tadi ada yang keliru.
teks_en: The Mist of Forgetting can get inside a screen, Mbah? No wonder that post had mistakes in it.

teks_id: Kabut itu pandai bersembunyi, Le. Di layar, ia menyelinap di antara pesan, foto, dan kabar yang lewat cepat sekali. Serpihan kelima tersangkut di sana.
teks_en: That mist is good at hiding, my boy. On a screen, it slips in among the messages, photos, and news that rush past. The fifth shard is caught in there.

teks_id: Jadi bukan layarnya yang jahat, ya, Mbah? Kabutnya yang harus kita usir.
teks_en: So it isn't the screen that's bad, is it, Mbah? It's the mist we have to chase away.

teks_id: Betul, Le. Layar bisa menjadi jendela ilmu. Kali ini, penjelajah, kamulah yang memegang layarnya. Bayangkan setiap cerita terjadi padamu.
teks_en: That's right, my boy. A screen can be a window to knowledge. This time, explorer, you are the one holding the screen. Imagine each story is happening to you.

teks_id: Mbah, empat serpihan Magelang sudah kembali. Serpihan kelima pasti tersangkut di layar lagi, ya?
teks_en: Mbah, four of Magelang's shards are back. The fifth one must be caught in a screen again, right?

teks_id: Benar, Le. Lihat rumah baca di ujung jalan itu. Ponsel anak-anak di sana terus berbunyi, dan kabut tipis keluar dari layarnya.
teks_en: That's right, my boy. Look at the reading house at the end of the road. The children's phones there keep chiming, and a thin mist is drifting out of the screens.

teks_id: Mbah masih lemas. Mbah istirahat saja di sini, ya. Biar aku yang ke sana.
teks_en: You're still weak, Mbah. Please rest here. I'll go over there.

teks_id: Pergilah, Le. Kamu sudah menyusun relief dan memisahkan fakta dari pendapat. Sekarang ajak penjelajah bersamamu.
teks_en: Go, my boy. You have put the reliefs back in order and separated facts from opinions. Now take the explorer with you.

teks_id: Baik, Mbah. Kami akan berpikir dulu sebelum memilih.
teks_en: All right, Mbah. We'll think before we choose.

teks_id: Penjelajah, bayangkan setiap cerita itu terjadi padamu. Pilihanmu yang akan menyibak kabut di layar Magelang.
teks_en: Explorer, imagine each of these stories is happening to you. Your choices will clear the mist from Magelang's screens.

teks_id: Mbah! Empat serpihan Wonosobo sudah kembali. Tinggal satu lagi, yang terakhir!
teks_en: Mbah! Four of Wonosobo's shards are back. Only one left, the very last one!

teks_id: Serpihan terakhir tersembunyi paling dalam, Le. Kabut Lupa membawanya ke layar-layar di seluruh Dieng, dari ponsel di rumah warga sampai tablet di sekolah.
teks_en: The last shard is hidden the deepest, my boy. The Mist of Forgetting has carried it into screens all over Dieng, from the phones in people's homes to the tablets at school.

teks_id: Di seluruh Dieng? Banyak sekali, Mbah...
teks_en: All over Dieng? That's so many, Mbah...

teks_id: Mbah tetap menunggu di tepi telaga ini, Le. Dari sini, Mbah bisa melihat setiap layar yang kembali terang.
teks_en: I'll keep waiting here on the lake shore, my boy. From here, I can see every screen that grows bright again.

teks_id: Aku akan mengingat semua yang sudah kita lalui, Mbah. Aku akan membaca setiap cerita dengan teliti.
teks_en: I will remember everything we have been through, Mbah. I will read every story carefully.

teks_id: Itu bekal yang cukup. Penjelajah, inilah layar terakhir. Bayangkan setiap cerita terjadi padamu, lalu pikirkan baik-baik.
teks_en: That is all you need. Explorer, this is the last screen. Imagine each story is happening to you, then think it through.

teks_id: Lihat, Le! Kabut di Temanggung tersibak. Papan petunjuk bisa dibaca lagi, dan warga sudah menemukan jalan pulang.
teks_en: Look, my boy! The mist over Temanggung has parted. The signposts can be read again, and people have found their way home.

teks_id: Kabut di layar tablet itu juga hilang, Mbah! Kelima serpihan sudah kembali ke lentera. Rasanya hangat sekali.
teks_en: The mist on that tablet is gone too, Mbah! All five shards are back in the lantern. It feels so warm.

teks_id: Anak-anak itu sekarang tahu, Le: data diri disimpan baik-baik, kata sandi hanya untuk pemilik akun, dan pesan yang aneh ditunjukkan dulu kepada orang tua.
teks_en: Those children know now, my boy: personal details are kept safe, a password is only for its owner, and strange messages are shown to a parent first.

teks_id: Itu hasil ketelitianmu. Pustaka Temanggung kini terbuka untukmu. Bacalah sepuasnya.
teks_en: That is the reward for your care. The Temanggung Library is now open to you. Read as much as you like.

teks_id: Terima kasih, Mbah. Berikutnya, Magelang!
teks_en: Thank you, Mbah. Next stop, Magelang!

teks_id: Dengar, Le... Kedua bapak itu berhenti bertengkar. Di papan informasi tertulis: Borobudur dibangun pada abad ke-8 dan ke-9 dari batu yang disusun saling mengunci, tanpa semen. Jadi, kabar kedua bapak tadi sama-sama keliru. Sekarang mereka membaca relief bersama-sama.
teks_en: Listen, my boy... Those two men have stopped arguing. The information board says: Borobudur was built in the 8th and 9th centuries from interlocking stones, without cement. So both men's stories were wrong. Now they are reading the reliefs together.

teks_id: Anak-anak di rumah baca juga sudah tenang. Dan Mbah... Mbah sudah bisa berdiri tegak lagi!
teks_en: The children at the reading house are calm again too. And Mbah... you can stand up straight again!

teks_id: Mereka sekarang bertanya dulu sebelum membagikan foto teman, dan memeriksa dulu kabar yang belum jelas sumbernya.
teks_en: Now they ask first before sharing a friend's photo, and they check any news whose source isn't clear.

teks_id: Serpihan Magelang sudah kembali, dan tenaga Mbah ikut pulih. Pustaka Magelang kini terbuka untukmu.
teks_en: Magelang's shards have returned, and my strength is coming back. The Magelang Library is now open to you.

teks_id: Tinggal satu wilayah lagi. Wonosobo, kami datang!
teks_en: Only one region left. Wonosobo, here we come!

teks_id: Mbah! Aku berhasil! Aku mengajak warga bertanya kepada petugas resmi. Kata petugas, belum ada yang bisa meramal kapan gempa terjadi, dan tidak ada peringatan untuk Dieng. Warga sudah tenang lagi.
teks_en: Mbah! I did it! I got people to ask the officials. The officials say no one can yet predict when an earthquake will happen, and there is no warning for Dieng. Everyone is calm again.

teks_id: Mbah melihatnya dari tepi telaga, Le. Setiap kali kamu memilih dengan bijak, kabut di puncak dan di layar-layar itu menipis sedikit demi sedikit.
teks_en: I saw it from the lake shore, my boy. Every time you chose wisely, the mist on the peak and on all those screens grew a little thinner.

teks_id: Kamu sudah menemukan sendiri pesan terpenting dari Kedu, Le. Sebelum percaya, periksa sumbernya. Sebelum membagikan, pikirkan akibatnya. Kalau ragu, tanyakan kepada orang yang tepat, seperti guru, orang tua, atau petugas resmi.
teks_en: You have found Kedu's most important lesson by yourself, my boy. Before you believe, check the source. Before you share, think about what could happen. When in doubt, ask the right person, such as a teacher, a parent, or an official.

teks_id: Serpihan terakhir dari Wonosobo... sudah kembali!
teks_en: The last shard from Wonosobo... is back!

teks_id: Pustaka Wonosobo terbuka untukmu. Saat semuanya siap, kita pulang dan menyalakan Lentera Kedu bersama-sama.
teks_en: The Wonosobo Library is open to you. When everything is ready, we will go home and light the Lantern of Kedu together.

teks_id: Di puncak bukit, Jaka mengangkat lenteranya tinggi-tinggi. Kelima belas serpihan menyatu, dan cahaya keemasan memancar ke seluruh tanah Kedu.
teks_en: On top of the hill, Jaka lifted his lantern high. All fifteen shards joined together, and a golden light poured out across all the lands of Kedu.

teks_id: Kabut Lupa tersibak dari Temanggung, Magelang, sampai Wonosobo. Papan petunjuk terbaca jelas, relief bercerita dengan urutan yang benar, dan layar-layar di rumah warga tidak lagi berkabut. Pesan berantai tidak lagi langsung dipercaya dan dibagikan begitu saja.
teks_en: The Mist of Forgetting cleared from Temanggung to Magelang to Wonosobo. Signposts could be read clearly, the reliefs told their stories in the right order, and the screens in people's homes were no longer misty. Chain messages were no longer believed and shared without checking.

teks_id: Badan Mbah terasa segar lagi, Le! Tapi ingat, cahaya ini bukan hanya milik lentera. Cahaya ini hidup setiap kali seseorang membaca dengan teliti dan berbagi dengan bijak.
teks_en: I feel strong again, my boy! But remember, this light does not belong to the lantern alone. It lives every time someone reads with care and shares wisely.

teks_id: Aku akan terus menjaga cahaya ini, Mbah: saat membaca, saat memakai layar, dan saat budaya Kedu tampil di layar. Supaya Kabut Lupa tidak pernah kembali.
teks_en: I will keep this light safe, Mbah: when I read, when I use a screen, and when Kedu's culture appears on a screen. So that the Mist of Forgetting never comes back.

teks_id: Mulai hari ini, kamulah Penjaga Lentera, Le. Kamu juga, penjelajah. Bawalah cahaya ini ke sekolahmu, ke rumahmu, dan ke mana pun kamu pergi.
teks_en: From today, you are the Keeper of the Lantern, my boy. And so are you, explorer. Carry this light to your school, to your home, and wherever you go.

teks_id: Lihat! Kabut Lupa sudah hilang dari tanah Kedu. Temanggung, Magelang, dan Wonosobo bercahaya lagi berkat kerja kerasmu.
teks_en: Look! The Mist of Forgetting is gone from the lands of Kedu. Temanggung, Magelang, and Wonosobo shine again thanks to your hard work.

teks_id: Kelima belas Serpihan Cahaya sudah kembali. Sekarang tugas kita menjaga cahayanya, saat membaca maupun saat memakai layar.
teks_en: All fifteen Shards of Light are back. Now our job is to keep the light shining, whether we are reading or using a screen.

teks_id: Kamu boleh berkeliling lagi kapan saja: baca Pustaka Kedu, lihat lagi cerita penutup, atau ulangi tantangan. Jangan lupa mampir ke Balai Refleksi, ya. Mbah Kedu ingin mendengar ceritamu!
teks_en: You can look around again any time: read the Kedu Library, watch the closing story again, or replay a challenge. Don't forget to stop by the Reflection Hall. Mbah Kedu wants to hear your story!

teks_id: Temukan kuda-kudaan dari anyaman bambu yang dipakai untuk menari kuda lumping.
teks_en: Find the woven bamboo horse used for the kuda lumping dance.

teks_id: Temukan biji kopi yang tumbuh di lereng Gunung Sindoro dan Sumbing.
teks_en: Find the coffee beans that grow on the slopes of Mount Sindoro and Mount Sumbing.

teks_id: Temukan arca lembu Nandi, seperti yang ada di dalam Candi Pringapus.
teks_en: Find the statue of Nandi the bull, like the one inside Pringapus Temple.

teks_id: Temukan ikan uceng, ikan sungai kecil yang menjadi makanan khas Temanggung.
teks_en: Find the uceng fish, a small river fish that is a special food of Temanggung.

teks_id: Temukan bangunan kecil berbentuk lonceng yang berlubang-lubang. Di teras bundar Borobudur ada 72 bangunan seperti ini.
teks_en: Find the small bell-shaped structure full of holes. Borobudur has 72 of these on its round terraces.

teks_id: Temukan hiasan kepala dari bulu warna-warni yang dipakai penari tari rakyat dari Desa Tuksongo, Magelang.
teks_en: Find the colourful feather headdress worn by dancers of the folk dance from Tuksongo Village, Magelang.

teks_id: Temukan jajanan dari singkong yang dimasak, ditumbuk, lalu diberi gula. Jajanan ini membuat Magelang punya julukan khusus.
teks_en: Find the snack made of cassava that is cooked, pounded, and sweetened. This snack gave Magelang a special nickname. Diterjemahkan ulang: bank lama steamed; 08 kini "dimasak" (cek fakta MGL-35 di [25](25_CEK_FAKTA_BUDAYA.md): getuk dikukus atau direbus).

teks_id: Temukan benda dari tanah liat yang dibentuk lalu dibakar, buatan warga Dusun Klipoh.
teks_en: Find the object made of clay that is shaped and then fired, made by the people of Klipoh Hamlet.

teks_id: Temukan alat musik berbentuk tudung lengkung dari anyaman bambu. Dulu tudung itu melindungi penggembala bebek dari panas dan hujan, lalu diberi senar untuk dipetik.
teks_en: Find the musical instrument shaped like a curved hood of woven bamboo. The hood once protected duck herders from the sun and rain, and then strings were added to pluck.

teks_id: Temukan buah pegunungan yang mirip pepaya, tetapi ukurannya kecil. Buah ini tumbuh baik di udara sejuk dan sering dibuat manisan.
teks_en: Find the mountain fruit that looks like a papaya but is small. It grows well in cool air and is often made into sweets.

teks_id: Temukan keranjang bambu kecil yang dicelup-celupkan ke air mendidih. Nama alat ini dipakai untuk menamai mi khas Wonosobo.
teks_en: Find the small bamboo basket that is dipped again and again into boiling water. Its name was used to name Wonosobo's special noodles.

teks_id: Temukan daun yang diseduh menjadi minuman hangat. Daun ini dipetik di perkebunan Tambi yang sudah ada sejak zaman Belanda.
teks_en: Find the leaves that are brewed into a warm drink. They are picked at the Tambi estate, which has been there since Dutch colonial times. Diterjemahkan ulang: bank lama since 1865; 08 kini "sejak zaman Belanda" (cek fakta 27 Oktober 2026, [25](25_CEK_FAKTA_BUDAYA.md)).

teks_id: Di grup kelas beredar pesan dengan foto jalan rusak: "Jalan ke Telaga Warna putus karena longsor hari ini! Sebarkan!" Temanmu, Fikri, membalas: "Sudah kusebar ke grup keluarga." Lalu kamu melihat foto yang sama di sebuah berita lama dari daerah lain.
teks_en: A message with a photo of a damaged road is going round the class group: "The road to Telaga Warna was cut off by a landslide today! Share this!" Your friend Fikri replies: "I've already shared it to my family group." Then you see the same photo in an old news story from another area.

teks_id: Akun "Undian Carica Dieng" mengumumkan: "Ikuti undian, hadiahnya sepeda!" Untuk ikut, peserta harus mengirim foto Kartu Keluarga dan nomor HP orang tua. Temanmu, Sinta, berkata, "Aku sudah ikut, kok. Katanya aman."
teks_en: The account "Dieng Carica Prize Draw" announces: "Join our prize draw and win a bicycle!" To join, you must send a photo of your Family Card and your parent's phone number. Your friend Sinta says, "I've already joined. They say it's safe."

teks_id: Kamu mendapat pesan dari "Admin Sekolah": "Akun belajarmu akan diblokir. Masuk ulang lewat sekolah-kita.example/masuk dan tulis kata sandimu." Kamu melihat alamat itu berbeda dari alamat situs sekolah yang biasa kamu pakai.
teks_en: You get a message from "School Admin": "Your learning account will be blocked. Sign in again at sekolah-kita.example/masuk and type your password." You notice the address is different from the school website you usually use.

teks_id: Saat studi wisata ke Dieng, kamu memotret Nadia yang tertidur di bus dengan mulut terbuka. Teman-teman di grup kelas tahu, lalu menulis: "Kirim dong fotonya, pasti lucu!"
teks_en: On a school trip to Dieng, you take a photo of Nadia asleep on the bus with mouth wide open. Friends in the class group find out and write: "Send us the photo, it must be funny!"

teks_id: Di grup kelas ada video berjudul "Embun upas bisa membuat orang sakit, jangan keluar rumah pagi-pagi!" Video itu tidak menyebut sumber. Temanmu, Fikri, membalas: "Sudah kukirim ke grup keluarga."
teks_en: A video in the class group is titled "Embun upas can make people sick, don't go outside early in the morning!" The video doesn't give a source. Your friend Fikri replies: "I've already sent it to my family group."
